_comment: Where your resumes live and how to classify them. Copy to resumes.json. Gitignored, because the paths are yours.

folders._comment: Base variants. These are what a tailored resume is built from.
General-purpose versions, used when no variant fits better.
What actually went out. Read-only history, never offered for a new application.

_variantsNote: Order matters. The first pattern a filename matches wins, so put specific patterns before generic ones. `match` is a case-insensitive regular expression.

tags._comment: Marks the near-duplicate pairs. `absent: true` means the tag applies when the pattern does NOT match, so a file named '(no side project)' loses the tag. Recording it is the point: whether that entry helps is only answerable if the choice sits next to the outcome.
